_comment: R2880 sub7 — pre-rendered opening prologue narration page (512x512 PSMT4, pixel blob at file offset 1962944, 131072 bytes, bg index 15, ink index 0). JP transcribed from build/recon_v86/sheet-sweep/r2880s7_img0_512x512_p14_gray.png. English follows the official guide prologue (data/guide_full_text.txt lines 164-178) with names/phrasing matched to the v85 in-engine narration (tools/patch_r1193_narration.py): Kingdom of Duhan, Battle of Banquo, San-Goth, Venoa, 'Ortrud, later known as the Holy King', 'For thirty long years', 'Twenty years passed...'.

layout._caps_comment: PER-LINE cap = original JP line ink width (px). The MOVIE samples each subtitle line through a FIXED per-line UV window equal to the original JP ink width, so any English line wider than its cap is right-clipped at sample time. patch_r2880.py uses lines[i].cap (NOT max_line_width) as the per-line max_w in the shrink-to-fit loop and hard-asserts width <= cap. Caps from build/recon_v86/scenebug/cinematic/FINDINGS_per_line_caps.json (JP widths probe6 + engine UV widths GS dumps 105138/105205/105228).
